_metadata.description: Future expansion requirements for advanced DNS, multi-site, roaming, prediction, and topology work.

requirements.title: Technitium support is deferred to advanced DNS platform needs
requirements.description: The scenario shall add Technitium DNS Server support only when advanced recursive, authoritative, local-zone, or business DNS platform needs justify the added complexity.

validation.notes: Add Technitium adapter tests tagged [REQ:NM-P2-001] when the adapter is implemented.

requirements.title: Multi-site management compares network profiles across locations
requirements.description: The scenario shall manage multiple home, small-office, or client networks with site profiles, site comparisons, and fleet-level reporting.

validation.notes: Add multi-site tests tagged [REQ:NM-P2-002] when site management is implemented.

requirements.title: Roaming devices can keep network policy off-network
requirements.description: The scenario shall integrate VPN-back-home or endpoint-local filtering patterns so managed devices can preserve DNS/filtering policy when away from the local network.

validation.notes: Add roaming-device tests tagged [REQ:NM-P2-003] when roaming support is implemented.

requirements.title: Predictive recommendations use historical measurement evidence
requirements.description: The scenario shall use historical measurements to suggest router placement, ISP escalation evidence, hardware replacement, or policy changes with explicit confidence and supporting evidence.

validation.notes: Add recommendation tests tagged [REQ:NM-P2-004] once predictive analysis is implemented.

requirements.title: Advanced traffic analysis is consent-gated
requirements.description: The scenario shall add topology discovery, bandwidth attribution, packet-capture workflows, and security scanning only where operator consent, retention policy, and platform capability support are explicit.

validation.notes: Add consent and platform-capability tests tagged [REQ:NM-P2-005] before advanced traffic analysis ships.
